name.description: Name of the workflow created by this spec from the {@link #createWorkflow} API.

models.description:
Which {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s to register. If specified, it will take precedence over
{@link #modelFilter} and {@link #trainJobRun}.

modelFilter.description:
{@link Filter} for fetching {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s to register.
It will be only used if {@link #models} is not specified, and it overrides the {@link #trainJobRun}.

trainJobRun.description:
{@link MlModel.Train.JobRun} for fetching {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s to register.
It will be only used if neither {@link #models} nor {@link #modelFilter} is specified.

options.description:
Use this field to specify the {@link BatchJobOptions} that should be used for the distribute the registering
of {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s

title:
A {@link Spec} to orchestrate a model registry workflow to register {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s. Under the hood,
the workflow kicks off a {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.RegisterModelsJob}. This workflow outputs
a {@link File} that can be ported to the target environment and be used to load {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s in the
target environment. This can be achieved by configuring another workflow using
{@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.LoadModels}.

Note that at least one of {@link #models}, {@link #modelFilter} and {@link #trainJobRun} should be specified.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.RegisterModels
